scope: Signed one-time transfer-signer rotation; source/test closure only, no runtime change or rotation executed

implementation.console: issue-transfer-signer-rotation signs YOFC-AGENT-SIGNER-ROTATION-v1 with current private signer; binds gateway/generation/SPKI hashes/operator/expiry
implementation.agent: rotate-transfer-signer verifies current-signer signature and exact claims, durably consumes authorization, backs up old signer/token, atomically replaces signer
implementation.failure: mismatch, expiry, foreign signer, unchanged key, replay, or receipt collision leaves identity unchanged
